nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a socialist prime. If $a$ and $b$ are distinct natural numbers with $2 \le a \le p - 1$ and $2 \le b \le p - 1$, then $a!$ and $b!$ have different remainders modulo $p$.
nodes.title: Distinct factorial residues modulo a socialist prime

nodes.summary: A natural number $p$ is a socialist prime if $p$ is prime, $p > 5$, and the factorials $2!, 3!, \ldots, (p-1)!$ have pairwise distinct remainders modulo $p$.
nodes.title: Socialist primes
